subject.title: feat: add i18n support with zh-CN (Simplified Chinese) locale

question: Should ClawHub keep this app-level i18n/zh-CN request open as a deferred localization tracker, close it under the current no-translation-expansion policy, or sponsor a staged implementation now?
rationale: Current main does not implement the request, but related member comments say translation/i18n expansion PRs are not being accepted right now; automation should not decide the long-term localization policy.

options.title: Keep Deferred Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical future ClawHub localization request until maintainers revisit i18n scope.

options.title: Close As Not Planned
options.body: Make the current no-translation-expansion policy explicit on this issue and close it as a maintainer product decision.

options.title: Sponsor Staged I18n
options.body: Approve a fresh staged implementation with shell/head, typed keys, fallback/parity tests, translation review, and UI proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Keep Deferred Tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical future ClawHub localization request until maintainers revisit i18n scope.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc provided the clearest current product-direction signal by closing related localization PRs with the no-expansion rationale.
